harnessFiles.name: Preflight.fsx
Run-Preflight.ps1
harnessFiles.content:
#Requires -Version 7.6
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $RepositoryRoot)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$RepositoryRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $RepositoryRoot).Path
# Build the selected revision before running the actual serializer and Cosmos query wrapper.
dotnet build "$RepositoryRoot/src/Grace.Actors/Grace.Actors.fsproj" --configuration Release --nologo -v quiet -p:CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies=true 2>&1 | Tee-Object "$PSScriptRoot/build.log"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Grace actor build failed.' }
$binaryPath = "$RepositoryRoot/src/Grace.Actors/bin/Release/net10.0"
$refs = @('#I "' + $binaryPath.Replace('\','/') + '"')
$refs += Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $binaryPath -Filter '*.dll' | Where-Object Name -ne 'FSharp.Core.dll' | ForEach-Object {
    try { [Reflection.AssemblyName]::GetAssemblyName($_.FullName) | Out-Null; '#r "' + $_.Name + '"' } catch {}
}
$refs += '#load "Preflight.fsx"'
$refs | Set-Content -LiteralPath "$PSScriptRoot/Load.fsx"
# Requires the separately started, isolated local emulator at 127.0.0.1:18081.
dotnet fsi "$PSScriptRoot/Load.fsx" 2>&1 | Tee-Object "$PSScriptRoot/run.log"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Real Cosmos preflight failed.' }

limitations: No atomic snapshot, blob presence, cloud consistency, load or billing claim.
Repository existence uses real persisted Created events in this disposable preflight; production resolves repository scope via the existing repository actor.
HTTP authorization and production raw-field validation are covered separately by hosted tests.
The emulator and its isolated databases were removed after capture.

zeroEncoding.result: Accept omitted Size as zero; reject explicit null or malformed size; no source contract change.
zeroEncoding.source:
open Grace.Types.Common
open Grace.Shared.Utilities
open System.Text.Json
let file = FileVersion.CreateWithHashes "empty.txt" (String.replicate 64 "a") (String.replicate 64 "b") "" true 0L
let json = serialize file
printfn "%s" json
use document = JsonDocument.Parse json
let mutable field = Unchecked.defaultof<JsonElement>
printfn "Size present: %b" (document.RootElement.TryGetProperty("Size", &field))
printfn "ReferenceType present: %b" (document.RootElement.GetProperty("ContentReference").TryGetProperty("ReferenceType", &field))
printfn "Manifest present: %b" (document.RootElement.GetProperty("ContentReference").TryGetProperty("Manifest", &field))

operatorResponse.harness:
#Requires -Version 7.6
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $RepositoryRoot)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$wire = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'actual-zero-response.json'))
$record = $wire | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
$scope = $record.ReturnValue.Scope
$output = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'operator-saved-zero.json'
. (Join-Path $RepositoryRoot 'scripts/diagnose-directory-version-size.ps1') @scope -OutputPath $output
$env:GRACE_SERVER_URI = 'https://diagnostic.invalid'
$env:GRACE_TOKEN = 'isolated-operator-check'
# Replays the actual hosted response; validation and same-directory file publication use production code.
function Invoke-WebRequest { return @{ StatusCode = 200; Content = $wire } }
$parameters = @{} + $scope
$parameters.OutputPath = $output
Invoke-DirectoryVersionSizeDiagnosis $parameters
if ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($output) -cne $wire) { throw 'Published output does not match the actual admin response.' }
if ($record.ReturnValue.DeclaredLogicalBytes -ne 0 -or $record.ReturnValue.DistinctContentCount -ne 1) { throw 'Expected actual zero-length declaration.' }
Write-Output 'PASS: actual serialized admin zero response validates, publishes, and reopens unchanged (0 bytes, 1 distinct content).'
